name: WildQuest Day Camps
description_short: A nature day camp at Prescott Farm in Laconia, NH, running nine themed summer weeks for ages 5 to 14, 9am to 4pm, plus February and April vacation weeks. Campers spend most of the day outdoors with nature activities, animal and plant identification, arts and crafts, cooking, games and hands-on learning.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 non-refundable deposit per session, per child, holds each spot. Cancel more than four weeks before the session for a refund of everything else paid; within four weeks, refunds only if the spot is filled. No refunds for no-shows, missed days or weather.
